dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only Captain Hertha were here too...

dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: Oh, hello, Honorary Knight! I'm Captain Hertha's subordinate... uh, or rather, her former subordinate. My name is Erminie Sprengel, and I'm currently assisting the Grand Master with logistics.

dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: ...Having said that, Sir Anselm's really the one who's handling practically all the logistics work. I mostly help those idiots over at 8th Coy with their gear.

dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: You know, stuff like explosives, explosives, and more explosives...

dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: ...Seriously though, who apart from that idiot Ematol would like this sort of work? *sigh* Captain Hertha... When will I finally get to do the kind of work that Captain Hertha does...?

dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: To keep those juiceheads from blowing up the camp entirely after a night out, I've no choice but to help come up with explosive devices that are safer to handle...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the explosive devices...

dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: Oh no, please don't get me wrong, Honorary Knight! I'm no explosives expert! I don't really have much to tell you in response to that question.

dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: Initiation sensitivity, oxygen balance, detonation velocity, detonation pressure, all that kind of stuff? I don't know the first thing about any of those! It was just by chance — yes, by chance! — that I happened to hear my childhood friend Ematol rattling on about them, that's all!

dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: As for how to mix together different liquid explosives, or coming up with safe blasting methods that ensure a fast reaction, and all that jazz? That has even less to do with me! That's all the work of those 8th Coy idiots!

dialogues.speaker: Erminie
dialogues.text: Like Captain Hertha, I'm a support knight who works in logistics. My only dream is to handle all the paperwork with grace and elegance, just like her!
